title: Quote stack
description: Pair with BOD-07 or after a feature run. Exactly three quotes, each under 25 words.
usage: Three short peer quotes in bordered cards under one heading. Locked layout — edit only text.
notes: The #7B8290 card border (border/primary) is left to the inbox in dark mode.
Heading uses f24 (28 → 24) per the convention table; the Figma Mobile frame keeps 28px.

Mobile: padding 48 snaps to 32 sides (mobPad32), 40 top (padd-top), 30 bottom (mob-pad-bot); card gaps 24 snap to 20 (himobtop); card padding 16/24 snaps to 10 top / 15 sides (padd-none, pad15), bottom stays 16 (Figma 8).
